visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a brightly lit gym, a man with a large afro wearing a white t-shirt and black shorts gestures with both hands towards a power rack while speaking to a man in a black hoodie and grey sweatpants. The man in the hoodie stands still, listening with a neutral expression. (2) The scene shifts to another part of the gym near a leg press machine; the man with the afro continues his animated gestures, using his fingers to count, while the man in the hoodie maintains his position. (3) The setting changes to a bathroom with light-colored tiled walls; the man with the afro is now shirtless, revealing a large eagle tattoo on his chest, and holds a silver shower head. The man in the hoodie is cleaning his own ear with a cotton swab while they engage in a close-up conversation.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 我們今天要座70公斤 4組12下. (2) [Subtitle]: We're going to do 70kg today in 4 sets of 12. (3) [Subtitle]: 4組12下會不會做太久. (4) [Subtitle]: Will 4 sets of 12 be done for too long? (5) [Subtitle]: 還是我們做3340公斤 做一下就好. (6) [Subtitle]: Or we do 3340kg, just do it. (7) [Subtitle]: 這樣一下就下課了. (8) [Subtitle]: So the class is over. (9) [Subtitle]: 教練為什麼 腿推拉要分三天練完. (10) [Subtitle]: Coach why, Leg push and pull, it will be practiced in three days. (11) [Subtitle]: 一天練完不是比較有效率嗎. (12) [Subtitle]: Isn't it more efficient to practice in one day? (13) [Subtitle]: 你覺得我在騙你錢. (14) [Subtitle]: You think I'm cheating you out of money? (15) [Subtitle]: 教練我不是這個意思. (16) [Subtitle]: Coach, that's not what I meant. (17) [Subtitle]: 我覺得有多收的嫌疑. (18) [Subtitle]: I think there is a suspicion of overcharging. (19) [Subtitle]: 一年要洗365次澡. (20) [Subtitle]: You take 365 showers a year. (21) [Subtitle]: 如果一天洗365次 就不用浪費水了. (22) [Subtitle]: And I wash 365 times a day, so I don't have to waste water.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A moderate-tempo boom-bap style hip-hop beat starts, featuring a clear electronic drum kit and a repetitive synth bassline. A male voice speaks rapidly in Mandarin with an inquisitive and slightly high-pitched tone, inquiring about gym sets. (2) The same hip-hop beat continues steadily. A second male voice, slightly deeper and more measured, responds with brief answers, creating a conversational back-and-forth dynamic. (3) The dialogue shifts to an absurd hygiene topic; the first male voice increases in pitch and arousal to emphasize the illogical point about showering frequency. The BGM remains constant throughout, providing a rhythmic bed for the high-density speech.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous comparison between the high-volume training logic of a gym and daily life hygiene to satirize over-training or inefficient workout mentalities. It presents a student challenging a coach's logic with an absurd hygiene analogy.
